title: Constitutional Active Reality Consolidation — Phase 1 Classification

steps.name: Non-destructive authority-chain classification and candidate extraction
steps.acceptance: Report lists every authority-bearing artifact from the first-pass scan with exact claim, claimed scope, granting source, active consumers, runtime reachability, conflict, disposition, and action owner. A Constitutional Candidate Ledger captures valuable unrepresented principles. No active files are moved/renamed/deleted.

steps.name: Founder review and disposition lock
steps.acceptance: Adam reviews the report and the candidate ledger; for each item the lock records retain / relabel / move / supersede / delete with rationale and owner.

steps.name: Implementation Engine lifecycle registry
steps.acceptance: A reusable script reads existing signals (BUILD_QUEUE.json, ENFORCEMENT_MATRIX, PRODUCT_REGISTRY, BP_PRIORITY, FILE_MANIFEST) and produces a per-idea lifecycle state from DISCOVERED → MATURE plus a maturity dashboard.

steps.name: Move, relabel, or archive approved dispositions
steps.acceptance: Each disposition is executed with a supersession receipt (old path, new historical path, prior authority claim, active replacement, reason, unique content preserved, affected imports, parity checks, rollback path). Active references are updated and proven not to read from history.
